acceptance_checks.then: roster/mcps.yaml versions.latest and versions.pins.stable for atlas-aci SHALL both equal 3.1.0
acceptance_checks.verify_method: cmd: yq read of roster/mcps.yaml; latest==stable==3.1.0

acceptance_checks.then: every digest recorded under atlas-aci versions.releases SHALL resolve to that tag on ghcr
acceptance_checks.verify_method: cmd: docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/rynaro/atlas-aci:<ver> --format {{.Manifest.Digest}} equals the recorded digest, for all 9 releases

acceptance_checks.then: cli/tests/mcp_images.bats S8-guard SHALL derive the expected digest from roster/mcps.yaml and fail when the fixture is stale
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: bats cli/tests/mcp_images.bats; teeth proven by reverting ATLAS_ACI_PINNED to the 3.0.2 digest and observing S8-guard fail

acceptance_checks.then: the full bats suite SHALL pass except any failure that also fails on a clean tree
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: make test (or bats cli/tests/), failures re-run on a stash of the change to prove they pre-exist

acceptance_checks.then: CHANGELOG.md SHALL record the bump, the signing and attestations, the #123 fix and an immutable-tag link
acceptance_checks.verify_method: grep: CHANGELOG.md Unreleased section names v3.1.0, atlas-aci#123, and links releases/tag/v3.1.0

acceptance_checks.then: the atlas-aci exposes_tools list SHALL remain exactly the seven MCP tools
acceptance_checks.verify_method: cmd: compare roster exposes_tools.list against upstream enforcement.READ_ONLY_TOOLS at v3.1.0
